# Pinned third-party source

This directory vendors unmodified, pinned source checkouts used by the v3 source-first adapters. See `../SOURCE_PROVENANCE.md` for repository, commit, symbol, license, and adapter mapping. Do not replace these directories with a floating `main` or `master` checkout, or copy their algorithms into local modules.

SINR is intentionally absent from this directory. It is maintained as the independent external pinned checkout described in `../SOURCE_PROVENANCE.md`.
